data.summary: In late October, Novaya Gazeta announced it was closing. They are now all collected in one place, free to read and fully searchable. One of the most unforgettable stories the outlet ever ran, back when it was called Novaya Ezhednevnaya Gazeta (New Daily Gazette), was its investigation of Russia’s black market in nuclear arms. Co-author Kirill Belyaninov told Meduza how he, Dmitry Muratov, and columnist Vladimir Filin set out to buy the makings of a nuclear bomb from Moscow middlemen.
